supersedes.reason: v1 mislabeled retained candidate-record route membership as the complete route top-40 proposal set

candidate_recall.greedy_set: selected_indices from the matching metric-specific greedy-reference row
candidate_recall.union_pool: original_index values in proposed candidate_records after total-cap allocation
candidate_recall.route_pool: original_index values in candidate_pool.route_proposals[route], including proposals later removed by total-cap allocation

metrics.macro_recall: mean_i |G_i intersect C_i| / |G_i| over nonempty G_i
metrics.complete_row_rate: fraction of nonempty G_i with G_i subset C_i
metrics.exclusive_route_hits: greedy indices present in exactly one complete route proposal set, counted by route

candidate_recall.empty_greedy_rows: exclude from macro and complete-row denominators; report count; micro denominator is unchanged
